==Description==
'''The Heavens''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]] that takes place on flying islands.

==Design & Path==
'''The Heavens''' takes place on two large flying islands in the sky, which are surrounded by clouds. There are also a few smaller islands near them in the sky. On the islands there are two towers and a castle with white walls and blue roofs. The castle is also surrounded by brick walls with towers at the edges. There are also many trees and rocks around the map, alongside multiple hills which can be used as cliff spots. Wooden fences and arches can also be seen near the path.

The path starts at a portal and ends at a cave. The path itself is curvy and takes multiple turns. The path also goes over a bridge, which connects the two main islands.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There are multiple u-turns on this map, which can serve as decent spots for your ground towers.
**These spots are also great for the [[Ace Pilot]].
*Cliff towers should be placed at the first island, as it has the highest amount of cliff spaces.
*Some ravines make it different to fully utilize the advantage of curves in the map. 
**Short-range towers, like the [[Assassin]] or [[Brawler]], might still be viable.
